Bought this late winter to use to haul firewood behind my Polaris 500 Sportsman. I was a little concerned about size and sturdiness for this application. No concerns after using it for 3 months! I added 3/4" treated plywood to the floor and sides to take the abuse of tossing logs in it. It's worked out great. Assembly was not complicated, went together in a few hours taking my time. It runs down the road and trail nicely and is about the same width as my quad so if the quad fits, the trailer fits! Photo is a partial load of oak. I've had it heaped right up and still pulled nice.
Excellent product, use on my tractor snigging logs
